title: Jiro Delight
description: Adds japanese famous ramen ''Jiro" to Farmer's Delight
body:
JiroDelight
![The Jiro ramen mashi mashi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acbe16b61d181d2dd92994cef82b3daf55b1ec97.png)


 

Welcome to the ultimate "Mashi-Mashi" experience.

JiroDelight is a Minecraft mod that brings the legendary culture of "Jiro-style" ramen to your world. By utilizing the cooking system from Farmer's Delight, you can prepare the ultimate bowl of ramen, packed with pork back fat and plenty of garlic, right in your own base.

Features
Garlic Farming: Grow your own garlic and harvest it for your recipes.

Noodle Crafting: Process wheat flour to create custom, thick noodles.

Jiro-Style Menu: Cook various levels of ramen—from standard "Ramen" to "Mashi" and "Mashi-Mashi"—with increasing volumes.

Cutting Board Integration: Use the Farmer's Delight Cutting Board to prep your garlic and noodles.

How to Play
Start by farming garlic and collecting pork back fat.

Use the Farmer's Delight "Cutting Board" to prepare your ingredients.

Put the ingredients and a bowl into a "Cooking Pot," and let it simmer to create your Jiro-style ramen!

Requirements
This mod requires the following mod to function:

Farmer's Delight (Required)

Credits
This mod utilizes the API from Farmer's Delight. I would like to thank the original author for creating such an amazing mod.

The JiroDelight Team
